name: Journal of Medical Extended Reality
description: Peer-reviewed journal dedicated to extended reality in clinical practice, education, and research.

name: Frontiers in Virtual Reality
description: Open-access journal covering virtual reality research, including a medicine and healthcare section.

name: JMIR Serious Games
description: Peer-reviewed open-access journal on games, gamification, and immersive technology for health.

name: IEEE VR
description: The long-running IEEE conference on virtual reality and 3D user interfaces.

name: IEEE ISMAR
description: International Symposium on Mixed and Augmented Reality, the main academic venue for AR and MR.

name: MICCAI
description: Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention society, relevant to surgical planning and visualization.

name: AMIA
description: American Medical Informatics Association, covering clinical informatics standards and practice.

name: Society for Simulation in Healthcare
description: Professional society for healthcare simulation, including accreditation and educator certification.

name: HIMSS
description: Health information and technology society covering digital health adoption and policy.

name: FDA — AR and VR medical devices
description: The US regulator's overview of augmented and virtual reality medical devices, with a list of authorised devices.

name: Immersive Learning Research Network
description: Research network and annual conference focused on immersive learning across disciplines.

name: Road to VR
description: Industry news and analysis covering VR and AR hardware, software, and platform shifts.

name: UploadVR
description: Daily coverage of virtual and mixed reality headsets, software, and industry developments.

name: VRScout
description: Immersive technology news covering applications across entertainment, enterprise, and healthcare.

name: Auganix
description: AR, VR, and spatial computing industry news with a business and enterprise focus.

name: AR Insider
description: Analysis and market data on spatial computing, augmented reality, and adjacent sectors.

name: AWE — Augmented World Expo
description: Long-running XR industry conference and expo series held across several regions.

name: Khronos Group — OpenXR
description: The open standard for XR runtimes and devices, which underpins cross-headset portability.

name: VR/AR Association
description: International industry association with regional chapters and a healthcare committee.

name: ACM SIGGRAPH
description: Computer graphics and interactive techniques community, where much XR display research appears.

name: PubMed
description: The US National Library of Medicine's index of biomedical literature, and one of the sources AVRMD's daily check polls.

name: ClinicalTrials.gov
description: The US registry of clinical studies, where XR trials are registered before results are published.

name: npj Digital Medicine
description: Nature Portfolio journal covering digital health interventions, including immersive and sensor-based therapeutics.

name: JMIR Publications
description: Open-access publisher of digital health research, including several journals that regularly carry XR studies.

name: RSNA
description: Radiological Society of North America, a major venue for medical imaging research including 3D and immersive visualisation.

name: Digital Therapeutics Alliance
description: Industry body defining standards and evidence expectations for digital therapeutics, including prescription immersive products.

name: openFDA
description: The FDA's public API for device clearances and related records; the source behind AVRMD's regulatory signals.

name: Laval Virtual
description: Long-running European immersive technology event with a recurring healthcare track.

name: MedVR
description: Community and accelerator programme for medical XR innovators, connecting hospitals, medical schools, and developers.

name: Reality Atlas
description: Public directory of the wider XR industry covering headsets, apps, agencies, events, funding, and jobs.

name: VRforHealth
description: Editorial resource on therapeutic virtual reality, publishing curated videos and articles on clinical applications.
